segments.sn35.63:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā migajālo yena bhagavā … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā migajālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.63:1.5: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, ekavihārī hoti, kittāvatā ca pana sadutiyavihārī hotī”ti?
segments.sn35.63:2.1: “Santi kho, migajāla, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.63:2.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.63:2.3: Tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī [nandi (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.sn35.63:2.6: Nandisaṃyojanasaṃyutto kho, migajāla, bhikkhu sadutiyavihārīti vuccati.
segments.sn35.63:2.8: Santi … pe … santi kho, migajāla, jivhāviññeyyā rasā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.63:2.9: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.63:2.10: Tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī.
segments.sn35.63:2.13: Nandisaṃyojanasaṃyutto kho, migajāla, bhikkhu sadutiyavihārīti vuccati.
segments.sn35.63:2.14: Evaṃvihārī ca, migajāla, bhikkhu kiñcāpi araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni [manussarāhaseyyakāni (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] paṭisallānasāruppāni;
segments.sn35.63:3.1: “Santi ca kho, migajāla, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.63:3.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.63:3.3: Tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandī nirujjhati.
segments.sn35.63:3.6: Nandisaṃyojanavisaṃyutto kho, migajāla, bhikkhu ekavihārīti vuccati … pe … santi ca kho, migajāla, jivhāviññeyyā rasā … pe … santi ca kho, migajāla, manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.63:3.9: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.63:3.10: Tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandī nirujjhati.
segments.sn35.63:3.13: Nandisaṃyojanavippayutto kho, migajāla, bhikkhu ekavihārīti vuccati.
segments.sn35.63:3.14: Evaṃvihārī ca, migajāla, bhikkhu kiñcāpi gāmante viharati ākiṇṇo bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi.

lines: Iṭṭhāti pariyiṭṭhā vā hontu mā vā, iṭṭhārammaṇabhūtāti attho.
Kāmūpasaṃhitāti ārammaṇaṃ katvā uppajjamānena kāmena upasaṃhitā rajanīyāti rañjanīyā, rāguppattikāraṇabhūtāti attho.

Tattha kiñcāpi abhidhamme nippariyāyena “nikkhamitvā bahi indakhīlā sabbametaṃ araññan”ti (vibha.529) vuttaṃ, tathāpi yaṃ taṃ “pañcadhanusatikaṃ pacchiman”ti (pārā.654) araññakaṅganipphādakaṃ senāsanaṃ vuttaṃ, tadeva adhippetanti veditabbaṃ.
Vanapatthanti gāmantaṃ atikkamitvā manussānaṃ anupacāraṭṭhānaṃ, yattha na kasīyati na vapīyati.

Vanapatthanti vanasaṇḍānametaṃ, vanapatthanti bhiṃsanakānametaṃ, vanapatthanti salomahaṃsānametaṃ, vanapatthanti pariyantānametaṃ, vanapatthanti amanussūpacārānaṃ senāsanānametaṃ adhivacanan”ti (vibha.531).
Ettha ca pariyantānanti imaṃ ekaṃ pariyāyaṃ ṭhapetvā sesapariyāyehi vanapatthāni veditabbāni.
Taṇhāsaṅkhātā nandī taṇhānandī, na tuṭṭhinandīyeva “nandiṃ caratī”tiādīsu viya.
“Imaṃ ekaṃ pariyāyaṃ ṭhapetvā”ti vuttaṃ tassa “pantānī” tipadena saṅgahitattā.
